description:
Get the list of holders for a specific Bitcoin Rune.

Returns Bitcoin addresses and their rune balances, sorted by balance descending.

Supports pagination for runes with many holders.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-60, default: 20)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

rune.description: Rune name (e.g., 'UNCOMMONGOODS' or 'UNCOMMON•GOODS') or numeric rune ID

name: runes_get_holders
